metadata.title: CFdino - Full Stack CFML
metadata.description: CFdino delivers expert ColdFusion and CFML development, legacy modernization, API integration, and scalable web solutions for businesses in France and the UK.

hero.title: Full Stack CFML
hero.subtitle: Delivering robust, scalable CFML solutions on ACF or Lucee with 25 years of experience. Available for freelance projects and long-term contracts.

services.subtitle: Comprehensive ColdFusion development solutions

about.title: About CFdino
about.intro_2: With over 25 years of specialized experience in ColdFusion development, I help businesses in France and the UK modernize and build robust web applications.
about.intro_3: I understand that ColdFusion remains a critical technology for many enterprises, powering mission-critical applications that require expert maintenance and enhancement. Whether you need to modernize legacy code, integrate new features, or build from scratch, I bring deep technical expertise and a commitment to quality.
about.point_1: Proven track record with enterprise-level ColdFusion projects
about.point_2: Flexible engagement models: project-based or long-term contracts
about.point_3: Strong communication and remote collaboration experience
about.point_4: Up-to-date with modern development practices and tools
